statements.status_notes: Loki Canary 3.6.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. Bumping to 0.311.3 is source incompatible with Loki 3.6.x and 2.9. Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping this track.

Loki Canary 3.6.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. The fixed Prometheus line in 3.7 drops github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which Loki 3.6.x still imports, and further source incompatibilities appear after patching that import (chunkenc.Iterator and PromQL parser API changes). Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping this track.

Finding targets Prometheus server remote-read: unauthenticated DoS via crafted Snappy bodies on /api/v1/read. Tempo does not serve Prometheus' TSDB remote-read endpoint; vulnerable HTTP handlers are not part of Tempo's exposed surface.

Finding targets Prometheus server behavior: the Azure AD OAuth client_secret for remote_write is exposed via Prometheus' HTTP /-/config API. This DHI image builds Grafana Tempo, which links Prometheus packages for metrics and querying; it does not run the Prometheus server or expose that configuration API.

CVE-2026-40179 is a stored XSS vulnerability in the Prometheus web UI, specifically in web/ui/mantine-ui/src/pages/query/uPlotChartHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/GraphHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/MetricsExplorer.tsx, and web/ui/react-app/src/vendor/flot/jquery.flot.heatmap.js. Telegraf vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus only as a Go library for metric parsing (prompb, promql, model packages) and does not ship the Prometheus binary, web UI handlers, or any of the affected frontend assets, so the vulnerable code is not present in this image.
